Judge Awards $250,000 to Musician Over Kennedy Center Trump Name Addition

A judge has ordered the Kennedy Center to pay $250,000 to jazz musician Samara Joy. Joy canceled a planned performance after the center announced it would add the name of former President Donald Trump to its "Political Theater" programming. The award amount is $252,480 according to one report. The musician had cited concerns over the addition of Trump's name.
